name: INV-04 - Revalidate Reviewed Invoice
purpose: Revalidate a human-corrected invoice after Power Apps marks it Ready for Validation, then apply duplicate checking and the same approval thresholds server-side.

trigger.action: When a row is added, modified or deleted

actions.name: Validate reviewed required fields
actions.notes: Require Invoice Number, Supplier Name and Invoice Total. Require cyg_manuallyreviewed = true. Human review replaces the AI confidence gate for this reprocessing path.

actions.name: Invalid reviewed data
actions.notes: If validation fails, set Needs Review with an explanation and terminate.

actions.name: List other matching invoices
actions.notes: Filter by escaped duplicate key and exclude the current invoice row ID. Top Count 1.

actions.name: Duplicate branch
actions.notes: If another row matches, set status Duplicate, save the reason, notify Finance and stop.

actions.name: Persist duplicate key
actions.notes: Write cyg_duplicatekey before routing. Alternate key protects against a concurrent duplicate.

actions.name: Route by amount
actions.notes: <= auto limit: Approved; > auto and <= manager limit: manager approval; > manager limit: manager then finance approval.

actions.name: Manager approval
actions.action: Start and wait for an approval
actions.notes: Persist outcome/comments and set Approved or Rejected for the manager-only route.

actions.name: High-value manager approval
actions.action: Start and wait for an approval

actions.name: High-value finance approval
actions.action: Start and wait for an approval

actions.name: Notify
actions.notes: Send the final or exception status.

loopPrevention: The trigger only reacts when status is Ready for Validation. The flow immediately changes status to Needs Review, Pending Approval, Approved, Rejected or Duplicate, so its own updates do not re-enter the routing logic.
